quizzes.title: Launch, Aim and Management: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: The Startup India Initiative is covered in the Polity and Governance section of the 2026 current affairs material. The topic came into the news because India marked a milestone anniversary of the programme. The booklet links this milestone with National Startup Day, which it describes as a day for celebrating entrepreneurial growth. The programme is run by a government department, and that department works within a larger ministry. The booklet also presents a table titled Terms Related to Startup Valuations. This table places labels against valuation levels, so that companies at different stages can be described using a common vocabulary. Each label is linked to a figure in dollars, and the labels appear in a fixed order in the table. The booklet treats the programme's institutional set-up and its valuation vocabulary as two separate areas of the subject. Both areas are part of its wider discussion of the initiative and of current affairs coverage in governance. Taken together, the material gives a basic picture of how the initiative is run and how startup growth is described. The same section of the booklet lists several schemes that operate under the initiative, each with its own purpose. Those schemes are presented as flagship schemes, and they cover areas such as seed funding and credit guarantees.

questions.q: Which of the following is the stated aim of the Startup India Initiative?
options: Regulating foreign investment in listed companies
Building rural road networks across states
Fostering startup culture and building an inclusive ecosystem for innovation and entrepreneurship
Setting national school curricula for entrepreneurship
questions.explanation: The initiative aims to foster startup culture and build an inclusive ecosystem for innovation and entrepreneurship.

questions.q: What valuation does a hectocorn represent?
questions.explanation: A hectocorn is a startup with a valuation of 100 billion dollars.

questions.q: What is the full name of DPIIT, the body that manages the Startup India Initiative?
options: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion
Department for Promotion of Information Technology
Department of Investment and Internal Trade
questions.explanation: DPIIT stands for Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The Startup India Initiative was launched in 2014.
Reason (R): The initiative is managed by DPIIT, which operates under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The initiative was launched on 16 January 2016, so A is false, while R matches the booklet's management details.

questions.q: Which term describes a startup with the potential to reach a valuation of 1 billion dollars in the near future?
questions.explanation: A soonicorn is a startup with the potential to reach a valuation of 1 billion dollars in the near future.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. A decacorn is a startup valued at 10 billion dollars.
II. A soonicorn is a startup already valued at 10 billion dollars.
III. The Startup India Initiative was launched on 16 January.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement II is wrong because a soonicorn is only expected to reach 1 billion dollars, so only I and III are correct.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. The Startup India Initiative is managed by the Ministry of Finance.
II. The Startup India Initiative is managed by DPIIT.
III. A soonicorn is a startup valued at 100 billion dollars.
questions.explanation: Only statement II is correct, since DPIIT manages the initiative, while the other two contradict the booklet.

quizzes.title: Eligibility and Core Features: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: The core features of the Startup India Initiative are set out in a list in the booklet, with several headings under which the initiative's provisions are grouped. The headings cover who qualifies, how the initiative eases the business process, what tax benefits are available, and what kind of funding support is offered. Eligibility is described in terms of the entity's location, its age and its size, which are measured in different ways. The booklet presents these conditions as a short checklist, so that a reader can compare the criteria side by side. Ease of doing business is listed under a heading of its own, covering several measures that the booklet says streamline processes for startups. The measures are presented as part of the initiative's core features, not as a separate scheme. Tax benefits form a separate heading, and the booklet presents them as applying to startups that meet the eligibility conditions. Funding support is listed under its own heading, which includes the Fund of Funds for Startups. Sector-specific policies appear as a further heading, and the booklet describes them as focused policies for particular fields. Taken together, the headings give a structured overview of the initiative's features, although the booklet presents each heading separately. Each heading is written as a short bulleted point in the booklet, so the details stay concise.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Maximum years since the startup opened   ->   B. Biotechnology, agriculture and renewable energy
II. Annual turnover ceiling   ->   C. 3 consecutive financial years
III. Tax exemption period   ->   D. Opened less than 10 years ago
IV. Sector-specific policies   ->   A. Less than 100 crore
questions.explanation: The booklet pairs the age limit with under 10 years, turnover with under 100 crore, tax exemption with 3 years, and sector policies with biotechnology, agriculture and renewable energy.

questions.q: Which of the following is listed among the ease of doing business measures for startups?
options: Mandatory physical inspection before every registration
Compulsory listing on a stock exchange
Fixed annual licence fees for every startup
questions.explanation: Simplified compliance is listed as one of the ease of doing business measures.

questions.q: The Fund of Funds for Startups supports which stage of funding?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Fund of Funds for Startups supports early-stage funding.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): A startup headquartered outside India can qualify under the initiative.
Reason (R): A startup must be an entity headquartered in India to qualify.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
questions.explanation: A is false because headquarters in India is required, which R states.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. A startup must be headquartered in India to qualify.
II. Opening less than 10 years ago is one of the conditions for a startup to qualify.
III. Annual turnover of 100 crore or more is one of the conditions for a startup to qualify.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement III is wrong because the turnover condition requires annual turnover less than 100 crore.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. Startups receive self-certification under the initiative's ease of doing business measures.
II. Eligible startups enjoy tax exemptions for 5 consecutive financial years.
III. Biotechnology is one of the sectors covered by sector-specific policies.
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while II wrongly gives five years instead of three.

questions.q: Which mechanism is used to streamline clearances for startups under the initiative?
options: Annual self-audit by the state government
questions.explanation: The initiative offers single-window clearances to streamline processes for startups.

questions.q: A startup must have opened less than how many years ago to be eligible? (number only)

questions.q: What is the annual turnover ceiling, in crore rupees, for an eligible startup? (number only)

questions.q: For how many consecutive financial years do eligible startups enjoy tax exemptions? (number only)

questions.q: Which ease of doing business measure lets a startup certify its own compliance? (one word)

questions.q: Which mechanism streamlines clearances for startups? (two words)

quizzes.title: Mentorship, Networking and Events: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: The Startup India Initiative's wider support system includes platforms that link startups with mentors and investors, along with a flagship event that brings the ecosystem together. The booklet presents these elements under the headings of mentorship, networking and events, which together describe how new ventures are connected to others. One platform is described in the booklet as connecting startups, investors and mentors, and it is treated as a recent addition to the initiative. A second platform is listed alongside it, and it is described through the functions it performs for the startups it serves. The flagship event is described as bringing together a wide group of participants, including startups at different stages, investors, industry leaders and ecosystem stakeholders. The booklet also states that the event has an edition scheduled to take place, with details of its timing and location included in the same section. Readers will find the platforms and the event described briefly, each with a single line of explanation in the booklet. The section therefore brings together three themes: the connections made through platforms, the networks formed through events and the mentors who support new businesses. Each of these items is kept separate in the booklet, so that a reader can tell the platforms apart from the event.

questions.q: Which group of cities does the BHASKAR Platform aim to empower?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the BHASKAR Platform aims to empower non-metro cities.

questions.q: Which of the following is the function of MAARG?
options: Intelligent matchmaking between mentors and startups
questions.explanation: MAARG offers intelligent matchmaking between mentors and startups.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The BHASKAR Platform was launched in 2023.
Reason (R): The BHASKAR Platform connects startups, investors and mentors.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: BHASKAR was launched in 2024, so A is false, while R is true.

questions.q: What does BHASKAR stand for?
options: Bharat Support for Knowledge and Research
Bharat System for Knowledge Access and Registry
questions.explanation: BHASKAR stands for Bharat Startup Knowledge Access Registry.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The BHASKAR Platform was launched in 2024.
II. MAARG stands for Mentorship, Advisory, Assistance, Research and Growth.
III. The 5th Startup Mahakumbh is scheduled in March in New Delhi.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement II is wrong because MAARG stands for Mentorship, Advisory, Assistance, Resilience and Growth.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. BHASKAR aims to empower non-metro cities.
II. The BHASKAR Platform was launched in 2022.
III. Startup Mahakumbh brings together startups, investors and industry leaders.
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while II wrongly gives 2022 instead of 2024.

questions.q: Which flagship event brings together startups, unicorns, soonicorns, investors and industry leaders?
questions.explanation: Startup Mahakumbh is the flagship event that brings together these participants.
